svg.title: VIEWE UEDX24320028E-WB-A V1.1 — 3.5-inch 320x480 — Fritzing breadboard view R3
svg.metadata: Header pitch: 2.54 mm center-to-center; 20 positions per long edge; 48.26 mm center span. Board proportions and component positions reconstructed from the supplied straight-on PCB photograph. Manufacturer sources confirm model UEDX24320028E-WB-A, ESP32-S3 N16R8, the separately selected LCD variant, CHSC6540 and peripheral GPIO mappings. Trace artwork is illustrative and is not an electrical netlist.
